data.spec: Thread one authoritative run id through Scheduler and AgentRunner so the agent actor, run marker, transcript record, and transcript filename agree. After every subprocess attempt, publish the captured transcript and run metadata through the durable transcript store before the worktree can be released, covering successful output, non-zero exits, timeouts, spawn failures, and event-ingestion failures without masking the original run error. Add scheduler/runner/store integration tests proving transcripts survive cleanup and sync, remain associated with the correct project/task/role, and are recorded exactly once for both success and failure paths.
data.title: Persist every agent run transcript
